title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: Think about what it means for data to be linearly separable. If you can draw a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) that separates the data into two distinct classes, then the data is linearly separable. Consider how transforming the data might help achieve this.

title: Exploring the Transformation
text: The transformation given is $$(x_1,x_2)$$ to $$({x_2}^2,{x_1}^2)$$. Think about how squaring each component might affect the data points. What happens to negative values? How does this transformation change the shape of the data?

title: Analyzing the Effect of Squaring
text: What happens to the sign of a number when you square it?

title: Visualizing the Transformation

title: Impact on Linear Separability
text: After applying the transformation, consider how the data points are distributed. Are they more likely to be separated by a straight line now? Think about the symmetry introduced by squaring each component.
